create_model_VGG: create a 2D SparseVggNet model with convolutional layers and batch normalization for Chinese handwriting classification
build_sparseconvnet_classifier: build a SparseConvNet classifier with InputLayer, SparseVggNet, and linear output layer for 3755 classes
run_classification_training: run scn.ClassificationTrainValidate to train the model with 100 epochs, initial learning rate 0.1, and weight decay 1e-4
get_dataset_iterators: get dataset iterators using get_iterators with spatial size and data scale of 63 for Chinese handwriting data
define_sparseconvnet_forward: define a forward pass that applies InputLayer, SparseVggNet, SparseToDense, and linear layer for classification
